prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory; command authority; no autonomous dispatch/control; segmentation/time-synchronization/health-checks/audit-logging required. Participants: local fire agencies/county emergency management/state wildland fire resources/aviation support units/cooperating public safety partners. North Lookout Camera Mast sends Thermal Spot Snippet/timestamped bearings/pan-tilt-zoom/confidence; South Lookout Camera Mast supplies triangulation/uncertainty/Camera Cleaning Log. Smoke Classifier Module supplies smoke/growth/obscuration/plume-confidence/Ridge Shadow Mask. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern) down-weights degraded evidence; produces traceable detections/recommendations/perimeters. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle) ingests observations/forecasts/quality-checks; supplies terrain-weighted wind/humidity/temperature/stability, visibility/Wind Shift Bulletin, time-indexed changes/recomputation flags. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall) opens triage; Duty Detection Officer (Orion) requests imagery, verifies evidence, records decisions. Confirmation: persistent smoke/thermal plus independent corroboration or authorized judgment; uncertainty remains triaged; dismissals searchable, without assignment/notification. Confirmed Ignition State allows planning, not dispatch without airspace approval. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): launch/recovery/charging/shelter; maintenance controller produces Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Pilot Operator checks endurance/return/safety; Drone Tasking Service prepares conditional missions avoiding aviation lanes. Imagery requires weather/airspace/communications clearance and orthorectification/grid-registration. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold) supplies lanes/status; Air Attack Supervisor (Redtail) deconflicts/verifies restrictions/windows/ground-clearance; receives columns/hazards/targets/timing maps retaining ground resources. Airspace Restricted State: authority-approved. Tanker Base Manager sequences readiness; East Retardant Loading Pump produces metered/sealed Retardant Batch Slip; West Retardant Loading Pump supports readiness. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger) preserves identity; impairment requires Orion alternate-contact verification before aviation acceptance. County Emergency Liaison receives confidence/threats/civil-coordination, not unnecessary tactics. Maps require confidence/age/error, provenance/times/version/acceptance/supersession; conflicts require review. Spread model combines perimeter/growth/weather/fuels into probability bands; overlays cover

New part:
S128: The Air Attack Supervisor reviews the promoted location, the confidence history, and the current airspace status before authorizing reconnaissance or retardant planning.
S129: The Drone Tasking Service converts reconnaissance objectives into trackable missions with launch windows, image requirements, altitude limits, and abort criteria.
S130: Horizon Ridge Drone Dock supports initial attack by keeping assigned aircraft charged, positioned, and ready for rapid launch when mission approval is granted.
S131: Kestrel is required to report launch readiness, aircraft health, and recovery availability before a reconnaissance task can be released.
S132: The Drone Pilot Operator confirms that the proposed route is consistent with field conditions and can be flown without interfering with suppression aircraft.
S133: Reconnaissance imagery is used to verify access, flame spread direction, and exposure to structures before crews are committed to a line assignment.
S134: The Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine compares recent reconnaissance observations with camera detections and weather-driven projections to support tactical recommendations.
S135: The Smoke Classifier Module remains a supporting source during suppression planning and is not treated as the sole basis for aircraft commitment.
S136: The Air Attack Supervisor uses the Wind Shift Bulletin to reassess aircraft sequencing, holding areas, and drop approach direction.
S137: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console maintains a planning view of tanker availability, estimated time to target, base turnaround time, and assigned incident priority.
S138: Marigold must prevent a dispatch plan from being released when required aviation approvals, airspace status, or tanker readiness fields are incomplete.
S139: The Airspace Restricted State limits dispatch options until the Air Attack Supervisor confirms that the planned route and working altitude are acceptable.
S140: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console produces the Runway Release Note after the planned departure sequence has been validated against runway constraints.
S141: The Tanker Base Manager uses the batch slip to confirm that the loading record matches the aircraft assignment and planned retardant quantity.
S142: The East Retardant Loading Pump and West Retardant Loading Pump report equipment state, flow readiness, and out-of-service conditions to support base capacity estimates.
S143: Loading status is displayed as operational information rather than as an approval, so a supervisor decision is still required before aircraft are committed.
S144: The Tanker Base Manager resolves discrepancies in loading status before the dispatch plan is presented as ready for release.
S145: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater provides an operational fallback for relaying approved aviation instructions when data connectivity is degraded.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
